responsibility: Defines regression and behavior tests for rustc_expand's parsing support, exercising string-based parser entry points, token-stream and token-tree construction, span and delimiter preservation, attribute/doc-comment handling, pattern identifier spans, parse error reporting, and helper code-pattern matching behavior used by this module's parsing utilities.
same_name_distinction: This `tests.rs` targets the `parse` submodule’s behavior on strings, token trees, spans, doc comments, and parse errors. In contrast to the root `tests.rs`, it mainly applies shared test helpers rather than defining them, and unlike `mut_visit/tests.rs` or `tokenstream/tests.rs`, its focus is parser-facing correctness instead of AST mutation or standalone `TokenStream` operations.
